values.note: The only electric site is 023 (50 amp, back-in, 35 ft), and ReserveAmerica designates it for campers with accessibility needs (proof of eligibility required), so no electric site is open to the general public.

hookups.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/wayfarers-unit--flathead-lake-state-park/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=312&contractCode=MT&parkId=630118 ('Type: Campsite Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 50', 'You have chosen to reserve a campsite designated for use by individuals with accessibility needs') + audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json (one Campsite Electric among 31 sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 30 campsites including a shared hike-bike site with 9 tent pads and five walk-in tent sites. ReserveAmerica's drive-in sites take 20-40 ft; seven are pull-throughs (four at 40 ft).

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/wayfarers ('There are 30 campsites in the park, including a shared hike-bike campsite with 9 tent pads', 'The maximum length for RV/trailer units is 40 feet') + audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json (ReserveAmerica driveway entries and max vehicle lengths), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water, the shower house and flush restrooms May through September; showers are coin-operated. Bear-resistant food lockers; firewood and ice sold.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/wayfarers (Amenities: 'RV Dump Station', 'Shower', 'Toilets (Flush)', 'Toilets (Vault)', 'Water'; 'Water Available May through September', 'Shower House & Flush Restrooms Available May through September') + ReserveAmerica park page ('comfort stations with coin-operated showers, boat and trailer dump stations, and firewood and ice for sale'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/wayfarers (Seasons & Hours: 'Campgound: Open April through October'; the park itself is open year-round for day use), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/wayfarers-unit--flathead-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630118 (Booking Window, Campsite and Campsite Electric: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance') + https://fwp.mt.gov/wayfarers ('Reserve a Campsite', 855-922-6768), read 2026-10-22

note: MT state park unit on the NE shore of Flathead Lake near Bigfork, in mature mixed forest; rocky shoreline and cliffs known for sunsets, boat launch (dock usable mainly mid-June to early September), playground and group shelter in adjacent Harry Horn Park. --Claude
summary: FWP page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 30 sites, 40-ft max, showers, flush/vault toilets, dump station, reservable on ReserveAmerica with the inherited 3-month window and 1-day cutoff; added pull-throughs, potable water (May-Sept), campground season April - October. The one electric site (50 amp) is ADA-designated, so no public electric is recorded (hookups note only). Fees left as recorded 2026-10-12 (FWP gives only the statewide $4-$34 range). Note trimmed of restated values and the 'open ~April-Nov' that FWP contradicts.
